name: agent-delegation
description: The delegation mode, subagent cap and model routing.

isOn.title: On
isOn.description: Applies the mode, the cap and the model routing.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Default: the main agent chooses when to delegate. Orchestrator: it delegates all work. No subagents: no new subagents.

open.title: Orchestrator may call
open.description: Tools the main agent may call in Orchestrator mode, separated by commas. Agent and Tasks each stand for their group of tools.
open.default: Agent, SendMessage, AskUserQuestion, Tasks, Skill, ToolSearch

cap.title: Subagent cap
cap.description: Subagents one session may start. 0 is no cap.

reader.title: Reader model
reader.description: The model of the reader agent.

editor.title: Editor model
editor.description: The model of the editor agent.

other.title: Other model
other.description: The model of every other subagent.
